archetypes.name: dyn-calibration-replay
archetypes.rationale: Calibration replay now reconstructs ballots and validates frozen fixtures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new calibration_replay helper and CLI wrappers for fail-closed behavior. Check source priority, jsonl truncation handling, plan extraction, repo-relative fixture validation, and neutralization parity. Verify tests cover the edge cases without relying on live run-log mutation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
